name: rear-lateral-raise-dumbbell-lying
title: Rear Lateral Raise: Dumbbell (Lying)
primer: This is an exercise for shoulder strengthening.
steps: Place the dumbbells at the head of the bench.
Lie facedown on a bench raised enough for your arms to move freely beneath it.
Place your toes on the floor in order to stabilize yourself.
Grasp the dumbbells with a 30 degree bend in your elbows. This is the starting position.
Raise your arms to shoulder height, maintaining a controlled motion.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
